thread:
maya (PM): Short follow-up from design review: quick decision on SLO slider copy + guardrail tone?
samir (prod-designer): Keep the three presets but show the ms values inline: Low (95ms), Balanced (200ms), Cost saver (500ms). Users kept asking 'what does 70 mean'.
tal (frontend): Agree. Also make aria-valuetext say the ms e.g. 'SLO target: 200ms (Balanced)'. Preset buttons should be real buttons with aria-pressed.
liam (eng-run): Runtime will accept slo_ms or slo_preset. We'll also return pool_capability with estimated p95 and a can_meet_slo flag so UI can show guardrails.
nana (a11y): Banner when pool can't meet SLO must use role="alert" and be visible in DOM. Avoid color-only cues; include an icon + short text.
samir (prod-designer): Draft banner copy: "This pool may not meet the selected latency. Request Dedicated or allow automatic fallback to hosted endpoints." Thoughts on tone?
maya (PM): Slight tweak: replace 'automatic fallback to hosted endpoints' with 'automatic fallback to our hosted endpoints' and add a small "Learn more" link. Keep it gentle, not scary.
tal (frontend): UX: show inline banner with actions [Request Dedicated] [Keep config]. If user picks Keep, show a 1-line confirmation: 'Allow fallback when queues exceed safe limits?' with details in a link.
nana (a11y): Confirmation dialog must trap focus, have clear primary/secondary labels: 'Allow fallback' / 'Do not allow'. Don't use vague verbs.
liam (eng-run): We'll default fallback_threshold conservatively and log it. UI should send allow_fallback boolean and optional threshold.
samir (prod-designer): Microcopy change: replace 'ephemeral' with 'temporary' everywhere. Users confused by ephemeral in tests.
maya (PM): Good catch. Also change 'Min'/'Max' to 'Min instances'/'Max instances' and show 'Total GPUs = instances × GPUs per node' under controls.
deploy-bot: Deploy preview queued: preview/autoscale-slo-guardrails -> staging. Build #9012.
tal (frontend): I'll test keyboard + VoiceOver on the preview and post any accessibility issues here by EOD.
maya (PM): Thanks all — tag any tiny copy nits in Figma and we'll ship after the staging pass."
